import { defineTable, col, rel } from "@rebasepro/server/schema";
import { area } from "./area";

export const areaType = defineTable("area_type", {
    columns: {
        id: col.serial().primaryKey(),
        name: col.varchar().notNull(),
        parent: col.integer(),
        childOrder: col.integer().notNull().default(0),
        description: col.text(),
        gid: col.uuid().notNull()
    },
    relations: {
        parentRelation: rel.belongsTo(() => areaType, { localKey: "parent", onDelete: "no action" }),
        area: rel.hasMany(() => area, { foreignKey: "type" }),
        area_type: rel.hasMany(() => areaType, { foreignKey: "parent" })
    },
    rls: "admin-only"
});
